plates.title: Build Plate Library
plates.subtitle: Measure a plate once; mounting it again loads its mesh and Z offset.
plates.no_plate_mounted: No plate is mounted. Mount one to load its mesh and keep its Z offset applied.
plates.z_waiting: applied when the printer is idle
plates.screen_z_note: The printer screen does not know this offset: its Z offset setting counts from its own value (0 after power-on) and sends the result, so its first press replaces {z} mm. Tune Z with “{live}” on the {page} page instead, then add the adjustment to the plate with “{edit}”.

plates.verify_failed: After the restart the printer did not report the plate mesh. Mount the plate again.

plates.invalid_name: Use a name of up to 64 bytes without quotes or backslashes.
plates.invalid_z: The Z offset must be between −1.000 and +1.000 mm.
plates.how_it_works: Side A prints with the printer's Side A mesh and Side B with its Side B mesh. Mounting a plate whose mesh is not there writes it and restarts the printer. The plate Z offset adds to the printer's own plate offset and is applied again after every restart.
plates.adaptive_note: Prints that level the bed first probe a fresh mesh; the plate Z offset still applies.
plates.offline: CC2 Control is not answering; the printer may be restarting.
plates.write_measure_confirm: Write the {temp} °C mesh of “{name}” to Side {side} and restart the printer? It takes about 1.5 minutes and switches the heaters off.
plates.save_measure: Save the printer mesh as a measurement
plates.nozzles_hint: The installed nozzle’s Z correction is added to the mounted plate’s Z offset, so one mesh serves every nozzle. Each calibration records the nozzle it was made with.
plates.nozzle_delete_confirm: Delete nozzle “{name}”? Measurements made with it keep their meshes.
plates.invalid_nozzle: Use a diameter from 0.10 to 2.00 mm and a Z correction from −0.500 to +0.500 mm.
plates.temperatures_note: Calibrate a plate at each bed temperature you print at: every result is kept as a measurement, and a print started here uses the one nearest to its bed temperature, loaded during the print start without a restart.
plates.print_mesh_waiting: A print is starting: CC2 Control loads the {temp} °C measurement once the printer has loaded its side mesh.

plates.print_mesh_missed: The last print reached its first layer before the {temp} °C measurement was loaded, so it used the side mesh.
plates.print_mesh_failed: The {temp} °C measurement could not be loaded for the last print, so it used the side mesh.
spools.title: Spools
spools.subtitle: Filament inventory, charged with what the printer really extrudes
spools.how_it_works: Each spool sits in a Canvas slot or on the external spool holder. While printing, CC2 Control charges it with the filament the printer actually feeds from that slot, purges and cancelled prints included. When filament is inserted into a slot or changed on the printer screen, every open page asks which spool it is.
spools.off_note: Tracking is off: prints do not change the spools and no questions are asked. The inventory can still be edited.
spools.no_canvas: The printer reports no connected Canvas: prints are charged to the spool on the external holder.
spools.question_hint: New filament: choose the spool so that its use is counted.
spools.tray_unknown: The printer has not reported this slot
spools.no_spool: No spool: this slot is not counted.
spools.differs: The printer reports a different material or colour for this slot.
spools.empty_list: No spools yet. Add the spools you own, or answer the question when you insert filament.
spools.delete_confirm: Delete spool “{name}”? Its history entries stay.
spools.new_spool_storage: A new spool goes into storage; choose it for a slot when you load it.
spools.new_spool_hint: Add it to the inventory with the filament the printer reports.
spools.invalid_material: Enter the material: up to 32 bytes without quotes or backslashes.
spools.invalid_text: Name, brand and note take up to 96 bytes without quotes or backslashes.
spools.invalid_number: Check the numbers: weights up to 20 kg, empty spool up to 5 kg, density 0.5–3 g/cm³.
spools.weigh_needs_tare: Enter the empty spool weight to subtract it.
spools.question_usage: {mm} mm extruded since then will be charged to the spool you choose.
spools.no_spool_hint: This slot’s use is not counted.
spools.write_printer: Also set {place} on the printer to this spool's material and colour
spools.untracked_toast: {place} is not counted until you choose a spool.
spools.print_no_spool: No spool in this slot: its use is not counted.
spools.print_need: {name}: {remaining} g left, the file needs about {need} g
spools.print_short: A spool holds less filament than the file needs. The print may run out.
spools.external_hint: For prints without Canvas, such as TPU: the spool on the printer’s own holder feeds the toolhead directly.
spools.no_suitable: No spool in the inventory has this filament. Pick one from all spools or add a new one.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Save application data on your computer and preview a selective restore.
backup.coverage: Includes interface preferences, material presets, the plate/nozzle library with saved meshes, and spool inventory and history.
backup.exclusions: Excludes passwords, network settings, firmware, print files and videos. Official A/B meshes not saved in the plate library are not included.
backup.integrity_hint: CRC checks detect corruption, not a trusted author. Restore only your own backups.
backup.restore_hint: Restore only while connected, idle and cold (nozzle/bed ≤50 °C, heating targets zero), with no other operation running.
backup.physical_warning: Restoring does not mount a plate, load a mesh or move the printer. Recheck hardware and restored measurements. Spool tracking starts off and physical slot assignments require confirmation.

backup.invalid_file: Choose a valid application backup of at most 512 KiB.
backup.counts: {plates} plates · {meshes} meshes · {nozzles} nozzles · {spools} spools · {events} history entries
backup.preview_hint: Selected categories replace current data; absent categories stay unchanged. Preview expires after five minutes.
backup.confirm_replace: Replace the selected application data? A local recovery copy is kept. Restored measurements and spool assignments must be checked against the physical printer.
backup.restored: Selected data restored. Check physical associations before using restored plates or spools.
